name: Quantivs Testimonials
author: fahadquantivs

sections.description:
Quantivs Testimonials allows you to easily collect, manage, and display testimonials on your WordPress website. With a modern, responsive design and flexible display options, you can showcase your customer feedback in style.

Key Features

  • Responsive grid layout with customizable columns
  • Star rating system
  • Multiple pagination options (Standard, AJAX, Load More)
  • Customizable colors and styling
  • Shortcode support with multiple parameters
  • Custom sorting and ordering options
  • Mobile-friendly design
  • Easy-to-use admin interface

Display Options

  • Grid layout with 2-5 columns
  • Adjustable items per page
  • AJAX loading for smooth user experience
  • Customizable hover effects
  • Responsive design for all screen sizes

Shortcode Usage

Basic usage:
[quantivs_testimonials]

Available Settings:
* testimonials_per_page (number)
* layout (grid)
* columns (2-5)
* orderby (date, title, author, random)
* order (ASC, DESC)
* pagination (numeric, ajax_numeric, load_more)
* show_ratings (true/false)

Additional Info

For more information and support:

  • Visit our website
  • Documentation
  • Support Forum

Credits

  • Built with WordPress coding standards
  • Uses modern PHP 7.4+ features
  • Follows WordPress security best practices

This plugin is GPL licensed and the source is available on GitHub.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quantivs-testimonials directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Testimonials screen to configure the plugin
  4. Use the shortcode [quantivs_testimonials] to display testimonials in your posts/pages
sections.faq:
Can I customize the number of columns?

Yes, you can set between 2-5 columns in the grid layout through settings or shortcode parameters.

Does it support AJAX loading?

Yes, the plugin supports both AJAX pagination and Load More functionality for smooth content loading.

Can I change the colors?

Yes, you can customize the hover color through the settings page.

Is it responsive?

Yes, the testimonials grid automatically adjusts to different screen sizes for optimal viewing.
